Editorial roles: Associate Editor, BMC Urology and SIU (Societe Internationale d'Urologie) Journal; Editorial Board of Neurourology & Urodynamics, International Urogynecology Journal, and Current Bladder Dysfunction Reports. Business/wealth signal: ICS financial disclosures (dated Jan 2026) list equity interests in UnivLabs and speaker honoraria from MSN Labs, Dr Reddy's Lab and Cipla. Prior appointments at Care Hospitals and Medwin Hospital, Hyderabad. Maintains an eponymous professional website (drsanjaysinha.in).
